question: What is our Flexible PTO and vacation policy regarding time off recommendations?

question: How are vacation days and vacation money handled for team members in the Netherlands?
ground_truth_answer: In the Netherlands, team members receive a statutory vacation money payment each May and are entitled to at least 20 vacation days per year which run concurrently with GitLab PTO. Unused days expire on July 1st of the following calendar year.

question: What are the rules for taking vacation time off in Brazil?
ground_truth_answer: In Brazil, vacation can be divided into up to 3 periods (one period at least 14 days and the other two at least 5 days each). Requests require at least 30 days notice, and 1/3 of vacation days can be converted into cash.

question: What is the Right to Disconnect Charter for team members in France?
